**Review: Sunbelt Charter Coaches — large event transportation**

Posting this because I know many of us use Sunbelt for airport transfers and offsite transportation, and CES bookings are coming up.

They handled two small airport runs well for me last spring, which is why I trusted them with a client dinner on Thursday, Nov. 5. I had 220 attendees, a 6:15 p.m. hotel pickup, and a ranch venue in Henderson. I booked four coaches and had the booking confirmed in writing twice, most recently on Tuesday, Nov. 3. The total was $8,400: a 50% deposit in September and the balance seven days before the event. Corey was the dispatcher listed throughout.

Only two of the four coaches showed up. The first arrived 55 minutes late, and the driver told me he had received the job at 5 p.m. The second broke down on the 215 with no working air conditioning, leaving attendees on the shoulder for roughly 40 minutes. The other two coaches never arrived.

I ended up putting 60 people in Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, costing about $1,900. Dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7:00, and the caterer charged me overtime. My client is now reviewing whether to retain me for its March event.

A late bus or a breakdown can happen. What I can’t accept is having no backup plan and no meaningful communication when half the booked transportation failed. I’ve requested a refund for the two coaches that never came, plus reimbursement for the rideshare costs. As of this post, the office line has gone to voicemail since Friday, and I haven’t received a refund or a resolution.

I’m not saying they can’t handle airport runs—my earlier experiences were good—but based on this event, I would not book Sunbelt for anything large until they fix dispatch and have an actual backup and communication plan. I’ll update this post if they resolve the refund.
